Name: Target Lock - Z-Targeting and Lock-On System
Author: sooualuna
Description:
[b]Target Lock[/b] adds a Z-Targeting / lock-on system inspired by action RPGs and The Legend of Zelda to Stardew Valley.
Lock onto a nearby monster and move freely while your Farmer automatically keeps facing the target. A visual marker follows the selected enemy, making combat easier to track and opening the door for more advanced directional combat mechanics.
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Lock onto the nearest monster[/*]
[*]Farmer automatically faces the locked target[/*]
[*]Move freely while maintaining the lock[/*]
[*]Animated target marker[/*]
[*]Automatic unlock when the target gets too far away[/*]
[*]Optional automatic target switching after an enemy dies[/*]
[*]Keyboard and controller support[/*]
[*]Prevents the lock-on button from triggering its vanilla action[/*]
[*]Fully configurable through Generic Mod Config Menu[/*]
[*]Public API for compatibility with combat mods and custom abilities[/*]
[/list][b]Default controls[/b]
Keyboard: [b]Z[/b]
Controller: [b]L1 / Left Shoulder (it's recommended to change to L3)[/b]
Press once to lock onto a target. Press again to release it.
[b]GMCM[/b]
Generic Mod Config Menu is optional but recommended. You can configure the lock-on button, targeting range, automatic target switching, target marker, input blocking and facing behavior.
[b]For mod authors[/b]
Target Lock includes a public API that other mods can use to retrieve the currently locked monster and the real-time direction from the Farmer to that target. This allows attacks, dashes, spells and other abilities to aim directly at a moving locked target.
[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu [i](optional)[/i][/*]
[/list]Made as part of an experiment to bring more action-oriented combat mechanics to Stardew Valley.
